bundle.shortDescription: A markdown editor that turns text and data into beautiful documents.
bundle.longDescription: Lumen is a local-first markdown editor with first-class support for Mermaid diagrams, ECharts, automatic CSV/JSON tables and charts, KaTeX math, Graphviz, PlantUML, sheet music, 3D models, and embeds.
